title: Spicy Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew originating from Egypt, made with tender fish, aromatic spices, and a hint of heat.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish pieces and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, chopped parsley, and spicy Egyptian paprika. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
